# NextDNS Provider

Manage [NextDNS](https://nextdns.io/) profiles with Terraform.

This provider is not affiliated with or endorsed by NextDNS.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Reads the API key from the NEXTDNS_API_KEY environment variable.
provider "nextdns" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) NextDNS API key, from https://my.nextdns.io/account. Can also be set with the `NEXTDNS_API_KEY` environment variable.
